# A2 Cafe
> Artisanal Coffee & Handcrafted Culinary Moments

## Overview
A premier artisanal cafe blending specialty pour-overs, handcrafted brioche burgers, and small-batch patisserie in an intimate, modern espresso lounge.
Established: 2024
Cuisine & Specialties: Artisanal Coffee, Gourmet Burgers, Continental, Specialty Desserts, Breakfast
Price Range: ₹₹ (Moderate) (₹300 – ₹700 per person)

## Operating Hours
- Mon – Fri: 8:00 AM – 11:00 PM
- Sat – Sun: 8:00 AM – 11:30 PM

## Menu & Offerings
Total Curated Menu Items: 13
Categories:
- Specialty Coffee & Brews: Ethically sourced, single-origin Arabica beans roasted in micro-batches and poured with precision.
- Artisanal Brioche Burgers: House-baked French brioche buns, melted artisanal cheeses, crisp organic farm greens, and secret sauces.
- Small-Batch Patisserie: Handcrafted daily by our pastry chefs using pure Normandy butter, Belgian single-estate chocolates, and seasonal fruits.
- All-Day Artisanal Breakfast: Wholesome sourdough toasts, organic farm eggs, açai superfood bowls, and cold-pressed elixirs.

Dietary Standards:
- Over 80% vegetarian menu items with dedicated separate cookware
- Plant-based milks available for all coffee beverages (oat, almond, soy)
- Gluten-free, nut-free, and vegan dietary flags indicated on every menu item
